about: Drive levels for the harmonic distortion charts in Erin's Audio Corner's 2020 driver reviews. Each chart is an animated GIF with one frame per level; each frame's title gives the level as the average SPL at 1 m over a stated band, and no voltage. The multitone charts of the same reviews (Test 1, midwoofer) list each drive voltage with its level on the same band, which fixes the level at 1 V; a frame's voltage is then 10^((level − level at 1 V)/20) V. A second check: the reviews say the first intermodulation test is always at 2.83 V, and its chart's level equals the 1 V level plus 9.03 dB within 0.4 dB on all five. The titles are whole decibels, so each voltage carries ±0.5 dB. Titles and legends were read by OCR (tesseract) and checked against those two relations.
